description: Thesis and mandate: turn limits into a draft trading-agent mandate in the Wever permission-slip format, marked as a draft for human approval. Inputs: assets, per_transaction_cap_usdc, daily_cap_usdc, daily_loss_limit_usdc, expires_at and, for a treasury agent, destination_allowlist, plus optional venues, order types, leverage and approval details. Returns the trading or treasury mandate with amounts in USDC millionths, how each limit maps to a field, the fields the principal, broker or agent still supply, a check against the permission-slip schema and rules, and a plain summary. Draft only: nothing is signed, issued or activated, and no money moves. POST /api/mandate-draft. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/thesis-mandate-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/thesis-mandate/.

assets.description: Assets the agent may trade (trading) or ["USDC"] (treasury).

daily_cap_usdc.description: Treasury: daily_withdrawal_cap. Trading: total position cap unless total_position_cap_usdc is supplied.

daily_loss_limit_usdc.description: Trading daily loss cap, including realized and unrealized losses, fees and funding.

threshold_usdc.description: USDC as a decimal string, up to 6 places and at most 1,000,000.

expires_at.description: UTC with whole seconds, for example 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z.

per_transaction_cap_usdc.description: Largest single transaction. Treasury: per_transaction_cap. Trading: each asset’s position cap unless position_caps_usdc is supplied.

additionalProperties.description: USDC as a decimal string, up to 6 places and at most 1,000,000.

profile.description: trading for an agent that trades, treasury for an agent that withdraws USDC. Defaults to treasury when destination_allowlist is supplied, otherwise trading.

starts_at.description: UTC with whole seconds, for example 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z.

total_position_cap_usdc.description: USDC as a decimal string, up to 6 places and at most 1,000,000.

name: wever_mandate-draft
title: Mandate draft
